title: Little Lambs
description: Ages 4-6. Foundational spiritual introduction, stories, simple prayers, and sacred hymn beginnings.
features:
Basic Bible stories
Simple prayers & hymns
Introduction to Ge'ez alphabet
Arts & crafts activities

title: Young Disciples
description: Ages 7-12. Deepening biblical studies, Church history, Ge'ez language, and liturgical chants.
features:
In-depth Scripture study
Ge'ez language lessons
Church history & saints
Liturgical music training

title: Teen Ministry
description: Ages 13-18. Orthodox theology, Christian ethics, leadership development, and youth retreats.
features:
Advanced theological studies
Leadership development
Community service projects
Youth fellowship & retreats
